items_missed: No agenda statement ("I'll gather some details, then walk you through pricing") or explicit "Sound good?" confirmation before diving into questions
Never asked about floors/access at the destination, packing needs, box count, storage stops, additional stops, or moving stressors during the probe

Pricing section skipped almost entirely — gave a single flat ballpark ($4,600) with no hourly rate, no what's-included list (gas, truck, insurance, wrap pads), no disassembly/reassembly mention, no No Worries Damage Coverage, no Meet Your Mover, no On-Time Guarantee, no no-hidden-fees pitch
Clock explanation (2.5 hr minimum, 15-min prorated increments, on-site start) never given

top_strength: Jespah recognized early that a small studio move to Brownsville would price out high and fast-forwarded straight to a ballpark estimate instead of running Eduardo through a full discovery he'd only lose on price — then proactively and helpfully walked him through PODS and U-Haul-loading alternatives once he said $4,600 was too much for his budget.
coaching_note: Even when pivoting early to a ballpark number, Jespah should still deliver the core pricing differentiators (hourly rate breakdown, no deposit, No Worries coverage, On-Time Guarantee) so Eduardo has more than a bare total to react to — he declined the $4,600 figure with zero context on what it included, leaving no room to reframe value against the cheaper U-Haul/PODS option he was already weighing.
phone_presence_notes: Genuine empathy shows up ("I totally get that and respect it," walking him through cheaper alternatives unprompted), but the delivery is hesitant and rambly, and the rep repeatedly loses track of the customer's name (Eduardo, then "Madi"/"Mari"/"Maria"), undercutting consistency.
audio_review_reason: The transcript around customer name/identification is garbled (rep calls him Eduardo, then "Madi"/"Mari"/"Maria") — worth confirming on audio whether this is a transcription artifact or an actual rep mix-up, since it affects the politeness/rapport read.
